lines.text: Welcome to Canopy Court, friends! I'm Moss. Light's pouring through the leaves, the birds are settling in, and the hoop is waiting.
Hey, hey, deep in the woods! Moss on the mic, coming to you live from Canopy Court. Find a stump, get comfy.
Ha, look at all of you up in the branches! This is Canopy Court, I'm Moss, and the Treetop Jam starts right now.
Good to see you under the canopy! Moss here. Breathe in that pine air, the Treetop Jam is on.
Rope bridge section, let me hear you! Shake those branches!
Juniper's on the front stump again! Twenty summers and counting, give it up!
Treehouse crew, I see you up there! Make some noise!
Hammock row, wake up! Ha, I know it's comfy.
Big love to the Birch twins, best seats on the log!
Owls in the back, I know you're awake. Hoot it up!
True story: this court was a fern clearing. We swept it out one Saturday and never left.
The trail mix stand has the good stuff today. Extra chocolate. Don't tell the squirrels.
A deer wandered onto the court last spring. Stood at the free throw line like it knew.
If it rains, no worries. The canopy's got us covered. Nature's own roof, friends.
You ever notice the owls go quiet right before a big play? They know something.
Campfire corn by the creek, friends. Trust me, best snack in the whole forest.
Lost a ball in the ferns last spring. A rabbit family lives in it now. Ha!
Hear that woodpecker? Keeps better time than our scoreboard ever did.
Ooh, the sap is rising!
Something's sprouting out there. I like it.
Wind's starting to stir in the branches.
Now the leaves are shaking!
Birds are paying attention now!
Feel that wind? The whole grove's leaning in!
The whole forest woke up!
Thunder in the treetops! Can't stop it!
Every branch is shaking! Every single one!
Oh, full storm in the canopy now!
Ha, bit of a frost out there.
Leaves falling, friend. Spring always comes back.
Quiet in the woods. Shake it loose.
That's your name carved in the big oak now, friend! The Treetop Jam belongs to you!
Whoa, what a show under the leaves! Go soak up that sunlight, you earned every bit.
Champion of the canopy! Ha! The birds will be singing about this one all week.
You came into these woods and took root. Take a bow, and come back soon.
Roots grow slow, friend, but they grow deep. Come back and run it again.
Hey, every big tree started as a seed. This hoop will wait for you.
The forest saw all that hustle. Rest up and come find me for a rematch.
Big respect from the whole canopy. Grab some water and come see us again.
Flight Night in the forest, friends! Two rounds, two dunks each, five judges on the log, and tonight's rival is waiting in the ferns.
Ha, the treehouse is packed, friends! It's Flight Night: two rounds, two dunks apiece, five judges watching, and a rival who wants it too.
Light through the leaves, hoop in the clearing, Flight Night is on! Two rounds, two dunks each. Five judges. One rival. Let's fly.
Back in the woods for another Flight Night! The birds remember you.
Ha, couldn't stay away from the canopy, huh? Another Flight Night it is.
The forest saved your spot, friend. Another Flight Night, here we go.
Tonight's rival just stepped out of the trees, and they came ready.
Say hello to tonight's rival! The forest has heard stories. Let's see if they're true.
Here comes Cass! Steady as an old oak. Same tomahawk, same landing, every single time.
Ty is in the woods tonight! Quiet, then thunder. Shakes every branch on the way down.
Pilot's here. Quiet as an owl, reads the whole forest, then swoops in.
Oh, it's Zo! Glows like a firefly for the phones. Here for the highlight, friends.
Stack is here! Climbs the tallest tree first, figures out the way down later. Ha!
Your turn, friend. The forest is listening.
Alright, the clearing's all yours. Go climb.
Here we go. Birds, hush up a second.
Step up. The light's on you.
Quiet now... this one's up.
Shake it off. Same tree, one more climb.
Ha, the hoop's still there. Go again.
No worries. Run it back.
Easy. Roots first, then branches. Again.
Last climb, friend. Make it count.
Third try. Even the owls are watching.
One more shot at this. Quiet, everybody.
Here it comes...
Go get it!
Up, up...
Climb, friend!
Wind's up!

Smooth as a river stone.
Solid roots on that one.

Player one, up into the branches!

Player one takes the duel! Highest branch in the forest!

A tie! Ha, side by side, like twin pines.

Downtown comes to the forest! Six shooters, five racks, sixty seconds, and the money balls. Top three move on.
Welcome to Downtown at Canopy Court! Five racks, sixty seconds on the clock, six shooters, and only the top three advance.
Ha, grab a stump, it's Downtown! Six shooters, five racks, sixty seconds. Watch those money balls. Top three go through.
